text:
Type: tufted kilim lumbar pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, rustic
Materials: printed woven cotton, raised cream tufted fringe bands
Colors: rust red, plum, terracotta, cream, grey
Shape: long rectangle, diamond kilim motifs, tufted zigzag and vertical bands, knife edges, slim
Feel: warm, earthy, lively
Goes with: cream or leather sofas, warm wood, terracotta, rattan; bohemian or Southwestern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Patterned Throw Pillow - 12 x 24 Inch, Multicolored Red
product.description: The lush textures and bright colors of this modern throw pillow create a blend of several geometric patterns in shades of red, white, and black, separated by lush, soft, fleece-like dividers. 100% cotton Imported 12"L x 24"W Beautiful pattern is printed on a machine-woven base. The tufted-yarn pattern adds texture and interest. 1 throw pillow Spot clean with a damp cloth, and then allow to air dry. Rather than pulling at any loose threads, please use scissors to trim them.
